singleMechanicsChange: When prescribed scalar displacement constraints span all three in-plane rigid modes, fit a best-fit translation/rotation, subtract it before the existing partition solve, solve the deformational correction with the existing dense/sparse solver, evaluate equilibrium on that correction, then add the rigid reference back to the reported displacement. Rank-deficient or zero-reference constraint sets retain the legacy path.
